incidents.name: TiFi flash-loan price manipulation
incidents.notes: The TiFi Finance contract sizes its payout from the TIFI pair's live reserves via its own router, so a flash loan moved that price and let the attacker withdraw far more WBNB than deposited.

sources.ref: onchain review: TiFi Finance 0x8A6F7834A9d60090668F5db33FEC353a7Fb4704B created 2022-11-12T06:02:56Z by 0x59348a46f527cb38494e4cc6cd64b7cd221fbddc, unrelated to attack sender 0xd3455773c44bf0809e2aeff140e029c632985c50; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 94.14 WBNB left the pair 0xb62bb233af2f83028be19626256a9894b68aae5e and the attack contract netted 87.14 WBNB; 87.1381 WBNB x $287.41 at incidentTimestamp 1670657465 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $25,044. Boundary row: the victim behaved as coded and the attacker moved the price it read.
